description: NexCode essentials: run button, project templates, GitHub, error explanations, shortcuts and languages.
cfg.ghClientId: Client ID of your GitHub OAuth App (Device Flow enabled). Leave empty to sign in with a personal access token.
cfg.predict: Suggest the next word as ghost text, learned from your open files.
cfg.explain: Show friendly explanations when hovering over errors.
cfg.recommend: Offer to install the recommended extension when you open a new language.
cfg.statusBar: Show NexCode items in the status bar.
walk.title: Get started with NexCode
walk.description: A quick tour of the most useful things.
walk.open.title: Open your project
walk.open.desc:
Open a folder to start working.
[Open Folder](command:workbench.action.files.openFolder)
walk.new.title: Start a new project
walk.new.desc:
Pick a ready-made template (web, Python, C++, Java...).
[New Project](command:nexcode.newProject)
walk.run.title: Run your code
walk.run.desc:
Press the play button at the top or Ctrl+Shift+F10.
[Run Current File](command:nexcode.run)
walk.github.title: Connect GitHub
walk.github.desc:
Sign in, then clone or publish projects.
[Sign In](command:nexcode.github.signIn)
[Clone My Repositories](command:nexcode.github.clone)
walk.ext.title: Add extensions
walk.ext.desc:
Add, remove or update extensions any time.
[Open Extensions](command:workbench.view.extensions)
walk.keys.title: Learn the shortcuts
walk.keys.desc:
Same shortcuts as VS Code, with a handy cheat sheet.
[Cheat Sheet](command:nexcode.shortcuts)
walk.lang.title: Change language
walk.lang.desc:
Arabic, English, French, German, Japanese and Chinese.
[Change Language](command:nexcode.changeLanguage)
